title: Ulyana and the Orbit
author: Bram Ashgrove
blurb: Wendell Ashgrove, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
